_doc: Model prices that are not committed (living/mind/src/prices.rs; docs/STORE.md, Model terms). Copy this to living/configs/prices.local.json (gitignored) or ~/.config/slop-living/prices.local.json, or point LIVING_PRICES at a copy, and fill in the prices. Without a file, or with null, a model's cost is unknown: journals record cost_usd null, never 0.
